summary: Full-stack testing of BERSINAR POS. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass (auth, products CRUD, inventory, tier pricing, Cash + Credit checkout with credit-limit enforcement, waste stock decrement, dashboard/profit-loss/receivables, admin role gating). Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080 desktop): invalid-login error shown, admin login redirects to POS, 12 seeded products render, category filter + search work, non-decimal product adds qty 1 to cart, decimal product 'Bayam Hijau' opens Numpad -> entering 5 confirms with Grosir tier price (Rp 10.000), cart total correct (Rp 88.000), Cash checkout computes change (Rp 112.000), transaction succeeds and Receipt modal shows invoice with Cetak + WhatsApp buttons. All nav links (Dashboard, Produk, Stok & Gudang, Barang Rusak, Pelanggan B2B, Piutang/Bon, Users, Kasir/POS) navigate correctly. Fullscreen toggle and location-switcher work. Role gating: kasir user does NOT see 'Pengguna' (Users) nav, admin does. No critical issues found.

minor.issue: Uses query params (product_id, location_name, new_qty) instead of JSON body — unconventional but functional.
Credit sale uses customer.current_credit stored on customer doc; concurrent credit sales could race (no transaction/lock). Acceptable for MVP.

category_series / profit-loss iterate ALL transaction_items ignoring the location filter when computing per-location figures (dashboard filters txns by location, but items are joined without location check). Minor data accuracy issue when a branch filter is applied.

issues: Seed data reuses one 'rice bag' image for ALL non-vegetable products (Air Mineral, Teh Botol, Gula, Minyak, Beras) — looks confusing visually. Consider per-product images or a neutral placeholder for non-fresh items.
Email/password fields pre-filled with admin credentials for demo convenience — should be removed before production.

action_items: (Optional) Make per-location filtering in /reports/dashboard category_series and /reports/profit-loss cogs_sold also honor the location filter by joining items->transactions.
(Optional) Replace duplicate rice_img seed image with per-category placeholders for Sembako/Minuman products.
(Optional, pre-prod) Remove hard-coded admin credentials from Login.js default values.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 770 LOC in a single file — split into routers (auth, products, inventory, transactions, reports) and models/seed modules for maintainability.
No request-level stock lock during checkout: concurrent carts could oversell since stock check and $inc are separate operations.
set_auth_cookie uses secure=True + samesite='none' which requires HTTPS — fine for prod preview URL, but local dev over http would fail silently; tests still work via Bearer token.
CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — functional but overly permissive; tighten to known origins before production.
Frontend keeps JWT in localStorage AND httpOnly cookie; XSS could leak the localStorage token. Prefer cookie-only once stable.
